stories.title: The art of winter layering
stories.excerpt: Puffers, knits and a little attitude: how to stay warm without looking bulky.
body: Layering is less about piling on and more about proportion. Start close to the body with a fine knit or a heavyweight tee, then build outwards with pieces that get progressively looser.
A structured outer layer, like a bomber or a leather biker, pulls everything together. Keep colours tonal and let one statement piece do the talking.
Finish with texture: a chunky beanie, ribbed socks, or a scarf in a contrasting weave keeps the whole look interesting up close.

stories.title: Your new weekend uniform
stories.excerpt: Soft sweats, clean sneakers and a coffee in hand. Effortless, on repeat.
body: The best weekend outfits are the ones you do not think about. A great sweatshirt, relaxed denim and a pair of box-fresh sneakers cover almost everything.
Pick a palette of two or three soft colours and everything in your wardrobe starts working together.

stories.title: Colour pop: wear the brights
stories.excerpt: Scarlet, cobalt and citrus. Why this season is all about saturated colour.
body: Bright colour is the fastest way to lift an outfit. If you are new to it, start with a single piece like a red dress or a vivid pair of heels and keep everything else neutral.
Feeling brave? Clash complementary colours such as cobalt with orange or pink with red for a look that turns heads.

stories.title: The thoughtful gift guide
stories.excerpt: Small luxuries and useful beauties for everyone on your list.
body: The best gifts feel personal without being complicated. Think about the little rituals people love, like a morning coffee, a candle-lit bath or a long walk with music.
Every gift ships wrapped with a handwritten note, so all you need to do is choose.

stories.title: Slow evenings at home
stories.excerpt: Candles, plants and ceramics that make any room feel like a retreat.
body: A calm home starts with light. Swap harsh overheads for candles and warm lamps in the evening.
Add something living, like a succulent or a cactus, and a few handmade pieces to make the space feel yours.

stories.title: Denim, done properly
stories.excerpt: From raw selvedge to patched and worn-in: finding the jeans that fit your life.
body: Raw denim rewards patience. Wear it hard, wash it rarely and it will fade to fit your body perfectly.
Prefer instant character? Pre-distressed, patched styles give you that lived-in feel from day one.
